headline: Floor Boss admits when the brain drove
lede: The never-dry stage tightened FLOOR BOSS's honesty stamp: a take is now only branded model when the autopilot actually drove a tick — and when it is branded, the over sheet says so out loud.

notes.text: Seat WATCH and hand back before the floor runs a tick and your take stays yours: the model stamp moved from the Y keydown to the tick that seats the autopilot pad (#2987).
A steered take that reached the bank now gets an amber BRAIN STEERED — TAKE OUT OF TRAIN plate on the sheet; a declined floor has no take to confess and stays silent (#2058/#2964 bank truth).
Conservatism intact: one steered tick poisons the whole career take across clock-ins; only a fresh floor clears the brand.

floorbosscheck +7 source pins and two mutants (stamp, peek) that die by name; floorbossplay drives real KeyY events through the brand, the seam and the declined silence. The mis-marked #2964 README bullet finally reads CLOSED so closed work stops re-kicking lanes.
